changelog:
v6.15 — Smoother updates: when an update APK finishes downloading while the app is open, an install prompt pops up right away (Install / Later) — no need to open the download notification first. When the app is in the background, the tap-to-install notification works as before.
v6.14 — New: Fake GPS detection. The main scan now includes a Fake GPS check, and a dedicated GPS Authenticity Test on the main screen samples your live GPS for ±30 seconds and scores it 0–100 (SAFE / SUSPICIOUS / FAKE GPS DETECTED) with a full session log you can view, copy, or share. It cross-checks the mock-location flag, satellites used vs claimed accuracy (a pinpoint fix with zero satellites used is flagged), positions frozen at one spot, sudden teleports, speed/bearing inconsistencies, and known fake-GPS apps. Devices without a satellite GPS receiver — such as Wi-Fi-only tablets — are supported too in NETWORK MODE and still catch mock locations.
v6.13 — Boot-scan accuracy fixes: the automatic scan no longer fires the instant BOOT_COMPLETED arrives — at that moment encrypted storage is still locked and root frameworks are not up yet, which produced anomalous 'clean' verdicts that then blocked the accurate post-unlock scan. The scan now waits until the device is unlocked, settles for 10 seconds, and runs a one-time confirmation scan ±90 seconds later that updates the result notification only if the verdict changed. The result notification also stays current: every manual scan in the app silently syncs it, so it never shows a stale verdict again.
v6.12 — Devices without a satellite GPS receiver (Wi-Fi-only tablets) are now supported too. The GPS Authenticity Test runs in NETWORK MODE on such devices: satellite checks are marked N/A, but the mock flag, accuracy patterns, teleports, speed/bearing consistency, and known fake-GPS apps are still analyzed and scored, with a network-mode verdict label. The Fake GPS scan check likewise probes a network fix on those devices (mock flag = DETECTED) instead of reporting no_gnss.
v6.11 — The main scan now includes a Fake GPS check (20th check), using the same flow as the GPS Authenticity Test: known fake-GPS apps are detected instantly, and — when location permission has been granted — the scan probes one live GPS fix and judges it by the mock flag and satellites-vs-accuracy (a pinpoint fix with zero satellites used is flagged). Without satellite GPS hardware, location permission, or a fix, the row reports UNKNOWN with the reason in its detail (no_gnss / no_permission / no_fix). The check also runs in the boot scan with the same graceful degradation.
v6.10 — New: GPS Authenticity Test (main screen button) for devices with a satellite GPS receiver — works across all Android brands. It samples live GPS fixes and real satellite data (GnssStatus; extras fallback on Android 5–6) for ±30 seconds and analyzes them for fake GPS indications: mock-location flag, satellites used vs claimed accuracy, fixes frozen at one spot claiming ≤5 m accuracy with zero satellites used, too-perfect constant accuracy, teleports, speed/bearing inconsistencies, constant altitude, overly regular update intervals, and known fake-GPS apps — producing a 0–100 risk score (SAFE / SUSPICIOUS / FAKE GPS DETECTED) and a full session log you can view, copy, or share. Devices without a satellite GPS receiver get a clear not-supported screen instead. Location permission is requested only when you open the test; the main root scan is unchanged. Full ID/EN.
v6.9 — Boot-scan notifications no longer show any time at all (no static posting time, no live timer) on both the progress and result notifications.
v6.8 — Boot-scan result notification now shows a live running timer (chronometer counting up in real time since the result was posted) instead of the static posting time.
v6.7 — Fixed incomplete language switching: after tapping the ID/EN button some texts stayed in the previous language (most visibly the "CHECK RESULTS" list header, which had no view ID and was never refreshed, and any string resolved through the Activity after a switch). The Activity's resources now always follow the active language and every visible text — list header, verdict, counts, scan time, check titles, bootloader card, disclaimer and footer — is rewritten instantly on toggle, including the pre-scan default verdict while a scan is still running.
v6.6 — Stability & speed release (full code audit). Fixed a force close a few seconds after launch: the OTA update dialog could be shown after the activity was already closed (BadTokenException) — now guarded. Scan is dramatically faster: all 19 checks now run in parallel, the su probe runs once per scan (no double su -c id, no double root prompt), shell output is drained concurrently (fixed a pipe deadlock that burned full timeouts), and shell timeouts were tightened. Faster startup: scan sounds now prepare in the background instead of blocking the main thread, MediaPlayers are properly released, and startup checks are cached. Boot scan fixes: the result notification no longer shares the foreground-service notification ID (it could be wiped by stopForeground), per-result notification sounds now use two dedicated channels (channel sounds are immutable once created), duplicate concurrent boot scans are prevented, failed OTA downloads no longer leave ghost files in Downloads, the boot log is size-capped, and the dex is now built for the declared minSdk 21 (lambda desugaring) so older devices can't crash on un-desugared bytecode.
v6.5 — Test release to verify the new built-in OTA downloader (own progress notification 0–100%, APK saved straight to the Download folder).
v6.4 — Fixed invisible OTA download: replaced the system DownloadManager with a built-in downloader that shows its own progress notification (0–100%) and saves the APK straight to the public Download folder.
v6.3 — Official English release notes published.
v6.2 — Fixed OTA update check URL to the correct public repository (droidforgeindo/DFDetector).
v6.1 — New: one-tap OTA updates via GitHub (automatic check max once per 24h, download via DownloadManager, tap-to-install notification).
v6.0 — Fixed force close when opening the About dialog (it was built with a locale-wrapped context lacking the Activity window token). Scan sounds switched from SoundPool to MediaPlayer for guaranteed playback.
v5.9 — Scan result sounds now play instantly with zero delay (preloaded at startup).
v5.8 — Removed the /data/adb module-directory check; added a "Test sound" button in the About dialog.
v5.7 — Removed the experimental toolbar reboot button; toolbar restored to original.
v5.5 — New: audio alerts — pleasant chime when clean, warning alarm when root is detected (also used by the boot-scan notification).
v5.4 — About, check-detail, and bootloader dialogs now follow the language switch immediately.
v5.3 — su binary detection now probes absolute paths (/system/bin/su, /data/adb/ksu/bin/su, …), fixing SukiSU/KernelSU devices where su was not on PATH.
v5.2 — /data/adb check falls back to su -c ls /data/adb so rooted devices get a definitive result instead of UNKNOWN.
v5.1 — Language toggle is now instant (updates rows in place instead of rebuilding the list).
v5.0 — Removed the unstable boot overlay; boot auto-scan is now notification-only (heads-up + full-screen intent + ongoing notification). Fixed su process deadlock during boot scans.
